summary: National Geographic: Merer's diary records 3-day boat journey from Tura quarry to Giza; workers loaded limestone onto boats, transported up Nile, tallied at administrative area.
content: Merer's diary records the three-day journey from the Tura quarry to the pyramid site: Day 25 hauling stones in south Tura; Day 26 set sail laden with stone blocks to Akhet-Khufu (Great Pyramid), night at She-Khufu (administrative area); Day 27 sail to Akhet-Khufu; Day 28 return upriver to south Tura. Merer's team of ~200 workers carried out all tasks related to construction. Ankhhaf, Khufu's half-brother, held position of 'head of all the king's works'. Papyrus H records payment of rations.
